description: This file defines the SalaryStructure class and related functions for managing salary structures, assignments, and salary slips within an ERP system, including validation, assignment, and slip generation.

classes.name: SalaryStructure
classes.description: Represents a salary structure with validation and employee assignment methods.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets default values for salary components if missing.

methods.name: validate_component_based_on_tax_slab
methods.description: Validates that salary components based on tax slabs are correctly configured.

methods.name: validate_amount
methods.description: Ensures net pay is not negative if based on timesheet.

methods.name: strip_condition_and_formula_fields
methods.description: Removes whitespace from condition and formula fields.

methods.name: validate_max_benefits_with_flexi
methods.description: Validates maximum benefits and flexible benefit components.

methods.name: assign_salary_structure
methods.description: Assigns salary structure to employees based on criteria.
